title: Sandiganbayan suspends Rep. Jojo Ang
summary: The Sandiganbayan Sixth Division has imposed a 90-day suspension on Uswag Ilonggo party-list Rep. Jojo Ang, who is facing graft charges over an alleged conflict of interest.
